name: [🍁PT2] Bubble Gum Simulator
desc:
Welcome to Bubble Gum Simulator!

🔥 Blow Bubble Gum to increase its size and jump into the clouds! Collect currency to buy upgrades and increase how big your bubbles can get!
🥚 Hatch eggs and get pets to accompany 
🍀 2x Luck and 2x Hatch Speed are enabled every Friday -> Sunday. Starting & Ending at 12AM PST!

🥚 New Radioactive/Poison themed egg! 
🔮 3 New Secret Pets!
🎃 Halloween Wheel Spin!
🧹 Halloween Pass! Unlock a new quest each day!
🏆 Halloween Quest Pass! Complete Quests on repeat to unlock the Haunted Gaze Pet & Boosts!
⚙️ Raised Boost Stock from Shard Shop from 12 Hours -> 18 Hours
🎁 Use codes 'Radioactive' & 'DumbPumpkin' for 12 hours of 2x Luck & 2x Hatch Speed!

A game by Rumble Studios.
